prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 23px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 766px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较六个重点城市四个季度的GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的变化背景。","reading":"读者先按行查看同一城市的季度变化，也会沿季度列比较城市；说明文字提供背景，通常在数值比较之后阅读。","groups":["第一列城市名称是行标识，应与同一行的数值和说明保持清晰对应。","第二至第五列都是季度增速，作用相同，应保持一致的宽度和节奏，方便横向及纵向比较。","第六列说明是较长的连续文字，需要更多宽度，并可利用数据行的高度自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称和季度增速数值应保持完整，不拆分。","尽量保持各季度子表头完整；总表头应清楚覆盖四个季度列。"],"may_wrap":["说明文字可按中文语义自然换行；各行已有的说明换行高度可容纳其他单元格的换行。","在优先为说明分配空间的方案中，季度子表头可以换行，但会增加表头高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it).
